game_title: Code Reading Relay – Palm Grove Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Palm Grove, a palm grove: the camel trader must handle dust devils while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Code Reading Relay: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line.
theme: Sand Dunes – Palm Grove: a palm grove
core_gameplay_loop: In Palm Grove, repeat each round: Read short programs as a relay and predict their output line by line. Each round, dust devils strike the oasis, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predicted value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the oasis from dust devils in Palm Grove: keep the predicted meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 59-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: predicted drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 59-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 5 (applied tier): Code Reading Relay
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predicted changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against dust devils in Palm Grove.
